LY-17 and 'fits' for an infinite width: the design (4.15 p.5) calls a width that is not a positive finite number a bad area (27, fits=false); the code does so. LY-17 therefore checks fits=true only for finite widths from 972 and any height from 594 (infinite height allowed), and the bad-area result for an infinite width. The wording of LY-17 in the table ('each area not less than 972 x 594') does not name this case; no code change needed.

LY-18 and 'no dead rows and columns' for 22-49 desks: by the definition of LY-14 (no two empty lines in a row, none at the outer wall) and not 'no empty line at all': the empty columns 10, 16, 22 exist there too, as at 19 desks (design 4.15, 2). The test checks that the violations list is empty and that row 9 is the only empty row.
